skill.name: peer-review
skill.description: Structured peer review toolkit for scientific manuscripts, grants, presentations, methods, statistics, reproducibility, ethics, figures, and reporting standards.
skill.summary: Review scientific work with structured checklists for methods, statistics, reproducibility, ethics, figures, and reporting standards.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from scientific review language or Markdown fences. Two examples intentionally invoke Python helpers through Bash, so external command execution should require confirmation and safe handling of user-provided files or text. No prompt injection, credential access, network exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: External Python helper commands appear in default review workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running Bash commands, and pass user text or file paths as safely quoted arguments.

remediation.issue: The skill references helper scripts outside this package.
remediation.suggestion: Document required script locations and verify the expected helper before execution to reduce path spoofing or accidental failures.

content.value_statement: Scientific reviews can miss methodological, statistical, and reporting problems when they rely on memory alone. This skill provides a structured review workflow with targeted checklists and constructive feedback formats.
actual_capabilities: Guides section-by-section manuscript and grant review.
Checks study design, methods, statistics, ethics, and reproducibility.
Evaluates figures, tables, accessibility, and data presentation quality.
Maps manuscripts to reporting standards such as CONSORT, PRISMA, ARRIVE, and STROBE.
Provides structured review formats with major, minor, and recommendation sections.
Includes presentation review guidance with slide-level visual inspection criteria.
limitations: It does not replace expert domain judgment or editorial policy.
It cannot verify claims without access to the manuscript, data, or supporting materials.
Some workflows reference external helper scripts that may not be installed.
It does not perform automated statistical recalculation unless supporting data are provided.

use_cases.title: Journal Manuscript Review
use_cases.description: Assess a submitted manuscript for novelty, design rigor, statistical reporting, reproducibility, ethics, and publication readiness.

use_cases.title: Grant Proposal Evaluation
use_cases.description: Review a research application for scientific premise, feasibility, innovation, methods, risks, and missing evidence.

use_cases.title: Internal Pre-Submission Check
use_cases.description: Find gaps before submission by checking reporting standards, figures, data availability, and revision priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Manuscript Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a full manuscript.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this manuscript for overall scientific quality. Summarize the main contribution, major concerns, minor concerns, and a publication recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Methods and Statistics Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review of study design and analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate the methods and statistical analysis. Check design fit, assumptions, sample size, missing data, effect sizes, and reporting clarity.

prompt_templates.title: Reporting Standards Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this manuscript against relevant reporting standards. Identify missing checklist items, unclear methods, incomplete results, and required author actions.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Reproducibility Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Deep review of transparency and replication support.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a reproducibility-focused review. Assess data availability, code access, protocol detail, materials, figure integrity, ethics, and exact revision requests.

output_examples.input: A clinical trial manuscript with unclear allocation concealment and missing confidence intervals.
output_examples.output: The review identifies allocation concealment as a major concern and asks for confidence intervals with effect sizes.

output_examples.input: A systematic review draft that lacks protocol registration and study selection details.
output_examples.output: The output flags PRISMA gaps, requests protocol details, and asks for a transparent study selection process.

output_examples.input: A slide deck with small figure labels and crowded methods slides.
output_examples.output: The feedback lists slide-level readability issues, recommends larger labels, and suggests simplifying methods content.

best_practices: Provide the manuscript, target venue, review criteria, and any required checklist.
Ask for separate major concerns, minor concerns, strengths, and recommendation sections.
Verify sensitive or high-impact claims with domain experts before sending the review.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to produce vague criticism without evidence.
Do not request experiments that are unrelated to the manuscript claims.
Do not treat the generated review as a substitute for ethical or statistical expertise.

faq.question: Can this skill review grant proposals?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for evaluating premise, feasibility, innovation, methods, and risks in research applications.

faq.question: Does it support reporting standards?
faq.answer: Yes. It references standards such as CONSORT, PRISMA, ARRIVE, MIAME, MINSEQE, and STROBE.

faq.question: Can it check statistical reporting?
faq.answer: Yes. It prompts review of tests, assumptions, sample size, missing data, effect sizes, and uncertainty reporting.

faq.question: Can it inspect figures and slides?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes criteria for figure integrity, accessibility, labels, layout, contrast, and slide-level formatting.

faq.question: Does it automatically verify data or code?
faq.answer: No. It can review availability and documentation, but verification requires access to the actual materials.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
